summary: Peak is a founder-backed early-stage fund with a €125,000,000 fund size and offices in Amsterdam, Berlin and Stockholm. Its Focus page says it invests in early-stage SaaS, marketplace and platform companies rather than particular industry verticals, that hardware is generally out of scope, and that it is a European investor. The homepage reports more than 50 investments across Europe and features companies such as VoiceLine and Gardia. Check size is not stated.
